findings.expected: Reference notes: Figma uses word-level breaks so Korean words are not split; Figma 15:34 keeps "위반·후보·공백이 0건이었습니다." on one line.

findings.fix: Keep middle-dot compounds together (for example a no-break joiner or line-break rule) and replay at 390.

second_pass: Not required: no P0 or P1 findings.
policy_notes: Side accents: the process rail (1px neutral track, purple scroll-progress fill, step dots) is a vertical rail at the left of the step list and is absent from Figma (F-04). The contract reports bars in existing-product QA only when a task trace shows harm; static captures show none, so it is recorded as a Figma difference and not as a side-accent violation.
Analyzer output in the Safari receipt (overflow, clipped and collisions all empty) was not used as proof; every pass above rests on viewed pixels.

Whether weight 600 is an intended Pretendard mapping for Figma Bold.

verdict.reason: At 320, 390 and Safari 402 the build departs from the approved Figma 14:2 on compared properties: type roles and colors, spacing, section chips, the result card, the process grid, a missing 본문 eyebrow and the related-list anatomy. Desktop has two internal alignment breaks. No text clipping, occlusion or task-blocking problem was seen, every finding is P3, and interaction states remain unknown.
